content: Careful deliberation before taking a step saves ten thousand paces of wandering in the dark.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: San si er hou xing (三思而后行) — Analects of Confucius (Book V)
explanation: Blind motion is not progress. People often rush into careers, relationships, and business ventures driven by frantic restlessness, only to spend twenty years disentangling themselves from the brambles. Spend the morning examining the map before you embark.
practicalInsight: Before agreeing to an enticing new commitment or contract today, take 24 hours of quiet reflection to assess its long-term weight.
reflectionPrompt: What major decision are you being pressured to make in a hurry that genuinely demands unhurried contemplation?
